note: Example data: an invented online coffee roaster with invented accounts, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. Podcast, review site and community names are invented too.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "self-reported-attribution" skill. We ask 'How did you hear about us?' on our Shopify order status page. Check the question, code the last 60 days of answers, and show me what GA4, Meta and Google Ads miss or over-claim.

business.name: Example Coffee Roasters
business.what: an online coffee roaster selling bags and subscriptions (invented)
channels_spent_on: podcast sponsorships: Example Morning Show, Slow Brew Hour
a stall at a weekend farmers market

conversion_point: Shopify order status page, shown after every web order

existing_question.text: How did you hear about us?
existing_question.storage: the survey app writes the answer and any Other text to the order's note_attributes

answers.source: shopify get_orders (note_attributes) joined to GA4 get_report on transactionId; first orders only, one CSV line per answer, empty cells mean no Other text, no GA4 match, or no Google Ads session
